name: Tetris Effect: Connected - Party Edition
summary: Tetris Effect: Connected Party Edition is loaded with exciting multiplayer modes from Tetris Effect: Connected, plus the exciting new Mystery Battle Mode! CONNECTED: Three players can team up and literally connect their Tetris Matrices to fight against A.I.-controlled Bosses. Mystery Battle: Up to four players can compete to be the last one standing while dodging unpredictable hazards. Zone Battle: A one-on-one match of standard competitive Tetris, but with a twist: the time-stopping Zone mechanic. Score Attack and Classic Score Attack: Two single-player versus modes where two players compete separately to see who can get the best score.
